gates.primary_across_IO: MODE4 default versus small full raw and consumed V bitwise; full N,W,C SHA and fixed2048 IDs,N,W,C bitwise; no error-based sample selection

checkpoint: each forward GPU atomically stores raw FP32 host sum(mode0) or persistent DP state(mode4) at each IO boundary, strict execution/geometry/mode/G/slab/progress/checksum/EOF identity. Completed rawV is SHA+identity committed before registered checkpoints are deleted. No full C/W disk checkpoint: explicit resumed inverse replays from committed fullV. No automatic retry or budget reset; interrupted unsubmitted case is preserved and blocks normal queue until explicit audit
pilot_stop: prefix and capacity both must pass. Before any complete case, compute conservative pilot estimate=1.5*48*(original first33M seconds+2*MODE4 first33M seconds)+3*225s inverse+3*90s full-field scans+120s CPU; if estimate exceeds remaining3600s budget stop with data and estimates.
